lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines traversing the lateral torso. Spacing is generally uniform, though distance between lines 8 through 12 on the posterior section shows slight compression relative to mid-torso spacing.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The anterior-most line segment is truncated, terminating before reaching the mid-lateral point. Several posterior lines show vertical abbreviation, failing to reach the ventral-most contour of the torso.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 6 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lateral posterior haunch, localized above the hind limb joint.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A subset of three spots on the mid-haunch aligns to form a semi-linear diagonal vector pointing toward the base of the tail.

other_distinctive_markers: Two distinct white spots located in the sub-orbital facial region. White transverse bands are visible on the proximal sections of the limbs.
